name: Network policy coverage
description: Fail workloads that are not selected by both ingress and egress NetworkPolicies.
long_description: ISM-1182 (partial): Findings show whether Kubernetes workloads are selected by ingress and egress NetworkPolicies; they do not prove that allowed flows match business need or that the cluster network plugin enforces the policies. ISM-1416 (partial): NetworkPolicy coverage is evidence of workload-level traffic restriction only; it does not prove host firewall coverage, approved application and service lists, or effective enforcement by the cluster network plugin.
remediation: Apply ingress and egress NetworkPolicies selecting each workload, then allow only required flows.

provenance.rationale: The upstream rule establishes the Kubernetes network-policy pattern; the local rule reports workloads not selected by both ingress and egress policy.
